name: Naxos Disease
aliases: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Dysplasia with Palmoplantar Keratoderma and Woolly Hair
ARVD with PPK and Woolly Hair

criteria.description: Presence of arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia confirmed by imaging or histology
Diffuse palmoplantar keratoderma manifesting in infancy or early childhood
Congenital woolly hair present from birth or early infancy
Positive family history of Naxos disease or sudden cardiac death
ECG abnormalities consistent with ARVD such as epsilon waves or T wave inversions in right precordial leads

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia, palmoplantar keratoderma, and woolly hair
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for plakoglobin mutations can support diagnosis

pathognomonic.notes: Present from birth or early infancy
Typically develops in infancy or early childhood
searchTerms: thickened skin on palms and soles
widespread hand and foot skin thickening

pathognomonic.notes: Structural and functional abnormalities of the right ventricle
searchTerms: right heart muscle disease causing arrhythmia
abnormal heart rhythm from right ventricle
heart rhythm problems in right ventricle

common.notes: Including ventricular tachycardia and premature ventricular contractions
Due to arrhythmias or cardiac dysfunction

laboratory: Genetic testing revealing plakoglobin (JUP) gene mutations
imaging: Echocardiography showing right ventricular dilation and dysfunction
Cardiac MRI demonstrating fibrofatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium
genetic: Autosomal recessive mutations in the plakoglobin (JUP) gene
other: Electrocardiogram abnormalities including epsilon waves and T wave inversions in V1-V3
Histopathology showing fibrofatty infiltration of right ventricular myocardium

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of palmoplantar keratoderma and woolly hair
Later onset compared to Naxos disease
Palmoplantar keratoderma and woolly hair present

redFlags: Sudden cardiac death in young individuals
Early onset palmoplantar keratoderma with woolly hair
references: Protonotarios N, Tsatsopoulou A. Naxos disease: a recessive arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy with palmoplantar keratosis and woolly hair. J Am Acad Dermatol. 2000;42(3):446-451.

McKoy G, Protonotarios N, Crosby A, et al. Identification of a deletion in plakoglobin in arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy with palmoplantar keratoderma and woolly hair (Naxos disease). Lancet. 2000;355(9221):2119-2124.
Sen-Chowdhry S, Syrris P, McKenna WJ. Role of genetic analysis in the management of patients with arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia/cardiomyopathy. J Am Coll Cardiol. 2007;50(19):1813-1821.
